gd_finding_category.format: One category word from the TA's 750-row lookup, keyed on the finding type. Left out of this sidecar: the full 750-row category table exceeds the 40 KB budget on its own; only the field's role is described here.

gd_severity.format: A decimal 1.0-10.0; higher is more severe.
gd_severity.quote: A critical severity level indicates that an attack sequence may be in progress or had recently happened.

examples.note: AWS's own published sample uses this placeholder; do not treat a literal epoch-zero time as real

ACTOR.note: Not observed; the documented complement of TARGET.

gd_action_type.format: One fixed word naming which *Action object under service.action is populated.

AWS_API_CALL.meaning: An AWS API call was observed.
AWS_API_CALL.note: Inferred from the service.action.awsApiCallAction.* columns present in the observed set; not seen as a literal string value.

DNS_REQUEST.note: AWS's Action object documents a dnsRequestAction sibling; the literal enum value itself is not printed on that page, only the object name.

KUBERNETES_API_CALL.meaning: A Kubernetes API call was observed.

RDS_LOGIN_ATTEMPT.meaning: An RDS database login attempt was observed.

INBOUND.meaning: The connection was made to the resource.
INBOUND.note: Not observed; the documented complement of OUTBOUND.

examples.note: the canary sample; EC2 did not block the connection

gd_launch_time.format: Unix epoch milliseconds, a raw number.

examples.note: = 2017-04-21T02:07:55Z; do not parse as a date string

gd_resource_type.format: One fixed word naming which *Details object under resource is populated.

AccessKey.note: Not observed as a literal value; inferred from the resource.accessKeyDetails.* columns being present in the observed set, which GuardDuty only populates for this resource type.

S3Bucket.note: Not observed as a literal value; inferred from the resource.s3BucketDetails{}.* columns being present in the observed set.

examples.note: FINDING_ID is AWS's own redacted placeholder in the doc example, not a literal value

PACKAGE_VULNERABILITY.meaning: A vulnerable OS or language package.

NETWORK_REACHABILITY.meaning: An unintended network path is open.

CODE_VULNERABILITY.meaning: A vulnerability in first-party or IaC source code.

insp_severity.quote: UNTRIAGED applies to PACKAGE_VULNERABILITY type findings that the vendor has not assigned a severity yet.

INFORMATIONAL.meaning: No significant risk on its own.

UNTRIAGED.meaning: The vendor has not yet assigned this vulnerability a score.

insp_first_observed_at.format: A ctime-style string: "Wed Sep 04 16:59:44.356 UTC 2024". Not ISO 8601.

YES.meaning: A fix is available through a version update.

PARTIAL.meaning: Some but not all affected packages have a fix.

examples.note: lowercase, unlike Inspector's own uppercase severity enum; the two are independent scores and independently cased

InternalAccess.meaning: Access granted to a principal in the same AWS organization or account.

UnusedPermission.meaning: A granted permission the principal has not used.

ACTIVE.meaning: The finding has not been resolved.

ARCHIVED.meaning: An analyzer rule archived the finding.

RESOLVED.meaning: The access or condition behind the finding no longer exists.

aa_principal_type.format: Only the observed sample's literal value is recorded; no fetched AWS page enumerates principalType's full set of literal values, so the rest are left out rather than guessed.

INTRA_ACCOUNT.meaning: The principal and the resource are in the same account.

aa_access_type.format: Only the observed sample's literal value is recorded; the cross-account counterpart's exact literal was not found on a fetched page.

APPLICABLE.meaning: An RCP applies and was evaluated.

FAILED_TO_EVALUATE_RCP.meaning: An RCP applies but could not be evaluated.

APPLIED.meaning: An RCP applies and restricts the access.

aa_scp_restriction.format: Only the observed literal is recorded; no separate AWS page enumerating this field's own full enum (distinct from the RCP field's) was found.

ACTIVE.meaning: Current; the default for a newly generated finding.

values.ARCHIVED: Hidden from view: the issue was resolved, the resource is gone, or the control is disabled.

values.NEW: Not yet reviewed; findings from integrated AWS services start here.
values.NOTIFIED: The resource owner has been told about the issue.
